svg.text: Every test run: answers that matched the rules, out of five, for each order
UHC, anemia drug, no cancer dx
A shaded cell had wrong answers; the darker, the more. Under the score: the most common wrong answer (+ when there was another). Times are Central.
The single call with Kanini Context's pages was given the documents the pack bound to each order, so it is not a fair no-context baseline.
